title: cutoffs per-decoy table, one row per recruit
body: A row per decoy rather than per pair: 42,195 distinct recruits against 11,224 families at sp-all, so about 42k rows and cheap. What goes in a row (which family recruited it, at what score, whether it was rejected) waits until the MGnify cutoff scale can be seen beside SwissProt's.
close_reason: superseded 6 Oct: reject writes rejects.tbl (family, target, evalue, score) and fill writes decoys.tbl (family, target), one row per recruit between them; the recruit score is in recruit's own tables
